name: HFb
label: e2e_lattice coherent-stage history (3D lattice 64^3) + fluid continuation
note: t, a = 1 and H_d at sigma = sigma_c of the homogeneous attractor (H_i/H_d = 1 + 2e-5). Part "lattice": box means of the 3D run (t <= 3 H^-1); part "fluid": HB.stage2 continuation of the end state [A]. The chain should splice e2e_kinetic fluid_HFb.json at t_sw in [1.5, 3] where the fractions are matched by moments; the lattice part is the coherent stage, the fluid part only gives K for this closure.

columns.R_rms: spatial rms of R(x) over the box (raw)
columns.s_mean: HFa: s_a/s_* box mean; HFb: s_b/s_*
columns.m_s2_mean: spectator mass^2 / H_d^2 box mean (HFa: (g_s v chi)^2; HFb: 9 - 3R/4)
columns.area: wall area per comoving volume from sign changes of the 0.05-averaged chi (H_d)

fluid_note: R_cyc here is (rho_s + rho_c)/M_P^2 in H_d^2 units (matter part only), as in hist_build
